# hallpass Provider

Manages a [HallPass](https://github.com/aurimasniekis/go-hallpass) gateway (a terminating SSH gateway for AI agents) through its API: agents and keys, servers and git remotes, roles and access profiles, host keys, login keys, policy, single sign-on and chat approvals. Authenticate with an API token (`hallpass_at_…`) created under **Administration → API tokens**.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    hallpass = {
      source = "aurimasniekis/hallpass"
    }
  }
}

provider "hallpass" {
  endpoint = "https://hallpass.example.com" # or HALLPASS_ENDPOINT
  token    = var.hallpass_token             # or HALLPASS_TOKEN (Administration → API tokens)
  # ca_file = "/etc/ssl/private-ca.pem"      # or HALLPASS_CA_FILE
}

variable "hallpass_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ca_file` (String) Path to a PEM file with additional CA certificates to trust (private PKI). May also be set with `HALLPASS_CA_FILE`.
- `endpoint` (String) Public URL of HallPass, for example `https://hallpass.example.com`. May also be set with the `HALLPASS_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) API token (`hallpass_at_…`). May also be set with the `HALLPASS_TOKEN` environment variable.
